label: 86 Chaos 16.0.115 Release Gate Credential Fallback
notes: Lets the release-gate runner skip temporary account auto-provisioning when Firebase Admin credentials are unavailable and verify already configured QA accounts instead.

Allows the existing generic service-account credential names, including FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS file paths, to satisfy testing credential lookup when they belong to chaos-test-d1601.
Keeps mutation safety checks on the testing Firebase project and avoids production Firebase mutations.
Preserves the already deployed Firestore rules byte-for-byte.
